verdict.rationale: Autumn's first-party docs describe an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to its billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools. The probe independently confirms a dedicated MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: detailed setup and authentication instructions for connecting specific agents, a full list of exposed tools, and independent hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
